boundary: Knowledge Base records how external papers inspire EcoMOF-AI workflow design, descriptor choices, evidence boundaries, and validation strategy. It does not claim EcoMOF-AI reproduces the original papers models or experimental results.
boundaryZh: 知识库记录外部文献如何启发 EcoMOF-AI 的工作流设计、描述符选择、证据边界和验证路线；不表示 EcoMOF-AI 已复现原论文模型或实验结果。
databaseIndexPreviewBoundary: V2.0-D Worker scoring boundary, loaded-scope dry run, Top-N explanation, detail checklists, and Candidate Compare operate only on currently loaded preview/index data. They are not full verified database screening.
databaseIndexPreviewBoundaryZh: V2.0-D 的 Worker 评分边界、已加载范围试算、Top-N 解释、详情清单与候选对比只作用于当前已加载的预览/索引数据；不是经完整验证的全量数据库筛选。
workerScoringBoundary: Full database scoring must be precomputed or run outside the browser main thread. The front-end worker boundary never fetches all parts or emits final recommendations.
workerScoringBoundaryZh: 全量数据库评分必须预计算，或在浏览器主线程之外执行。前端 Worker 边界不会读取全部分片，也不会输出最终推荐。
